## What changed

## Evidence claim template
- **Claim:**
- **Class:** publisher statement | observed fact | derived classification | analyst interpretation
- **Primary source:**
- **Locator:**
- **As-of date:**
- **Method:**
- **Uncertainty:**
- **Causality note:**

## Checks
- [ ] Primary citations and precise locators are included
- [ ] Fact and interpretation are separated; unknowns remain explicit
- [ ] No unsupported causal claim or party advocacy
- [ ] No copied source body, person profiling, address or unnecessary contact data
- [ ] Rights register updated if a permission claim changed
- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate.py` and tests pass
- [ ] Visuals include alt text

## Red lines (RED-LINES.md) — reviewer other than the author must tick
- [ ] R1/R4: no vote recommendation, no allegation of dishonesty or motive; `python3 scripts/red_lines.py` passes
- [ ] R2: any regulated-period spend added to SPEND-REGISTER.md
- [ ] R3: not merging on election day (7 Nov 2026 NZ time)
- [ ] R5: CORRECTIONS.md appended (not edited) if a correction is involved
- [ ] R6/R7: link-and-quote only; no personal data of members of the public
- [ ] R8/R9: surface carries accountability block; model outputs labelled with model, version, confidence, human-check status
- [ ] R10: new surface or red-line change has a REVIEW-REGISTER.md row
